mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_information (del_info_no, cust_id, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, payment_completed_no, sell_products_no, delivery_location_no, recipient_nm, recipient_phone, delivery_company, delivery_request, delivery_progress, depart_date, arrive_date, register_date) VALUES (#{delInfoNo}, #{custId}, #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{paymentCompletedNo}, #{sellProdNo}, #{delNo}, #{recipientNm}, #{recipientPhone}, NULL, #{delRequest}, '상품준비중', NULL, NULL, NOW())
mapper.select: select p.payment_key from payment p where p.order_id = #{orderId};
select q.quantity as quantity from quantity q where q.products_no = #{prodNo} and q.ent_ceo_no = #{entCeoNo};

select dl.delivery_location_no, dl.delivery_nm, dl.primary_location, dl.delivery_addr, dl.delivery_daddr, dl.recipient_phone, dl.delivery_request from delivery_list dl where dl.cust_id = #{custId} order by dl.primary_location
mapper.insert: /* 결제시 payment테이블에 값 등록 */ insert into payment (payment_completed_no, cust_id, sell_products_no, rental_contract_no, pay_info_no, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, manager_id, payment_type, contract_details, payment_details, payment_count, product_unit_price, total_price, payment_completed_date, payment_status, revision_date, payment_key, order_id) values (#{paymentCompletedNo}, #{custId}, #{sellProdNo}, '일시불판매', 'pay_info_3', #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{managerId}, #{paymentType}, '일시불판매', '일시불판매', #{paymentCount}, #{prodUnitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, CURDATE(), '정상결제상태', NOW(), #{paymentKey}, #{orderId})
mapper.select: select pd.products_nm, p.total_price, p.rental_contract_no, p.payment_completed_date, p.payment_status, p.order_id, p.payment_completed_no from payment p inner join sell_products sp on p.sell_products_no = sp.sell_products_no inner join products pd on sp.products_no = pd.products_no where p.cust_id = #{custId} group by CASE WHEN p.rental_contract_no = '일시불판매' THEN CONCAT(p.rental_contract_no, '_', p.payment_completed_no) ELSE p.rental_contract_no END order by p.payment_completed_date desc
